description: The result of each value of one analytic axis over a period, read from the posted ledger: the income, the expense and their difference per value, in the company's currency, from the whole income statement — salaries, rent and depreciation included, wherever they were split — and fixed_assets, the net movement of the fixed-asset accounts, beside the result and never in it. A value with others below it holds their subtotal; its own amount alone is in the direct_ columns, and level is its depth. unassigned is the part no share of the axis reaches and total the whole period: the direct_ amounts and unassigned add up to total, so say how large unassigned is rather than presenting the values as the whole, and never add a parent to its children. The margin of each product is a different question, read from the invoices. It prepares figures; it files nothing.

axis.description: The analytic axis, by its code or its id: list_analytic_axes names them.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.
